scope.goal: Track SDK consumer bundler compatibility for productization.

cases.notes: Validates typed errors, filesystem/package/process/project/preview adapters, trace events, mount-root containment, lifecycle retry and teardown, and the Cargo WebContainer-style facade.
Tarball-installed consumer imports @cargo-container/sdk root types and validates stable API surface.
Tarball-installed consumer verifies CommonJS conditional export exposes createContainer, createPreviewRelay, and protocolVersion.
Tarball-installed Vite consumer imports the root SDK package, builds successfully, and verifies worker asset URL strings survive bundling.
Tarball-installed Webpack consumer imports the root SDK package, builds successfully, and verifies runtime worker URL strings survive bundling when expressed from location.href.
Tarball-installed Rspack consumer imports the root SDK package, builds successfully, and verifies runtime worker URL strings survive bundling when expressed from location.href.
Tarball-installed Next app router client fixture imports the root SDK package with transpilePackages and verifies worker URL strings survive in client assets.

gate.reason: TypeScript bundler resolution, CJS require, Vite, Webpack, Rspack, and Next consumer build smoke pass. Vite works with direct runtime asset URLs; Webpack/Rspack use location.href runtime URLs; Next uses a client component with transpilePackages.
